populations.name: POP-B admissible pool (DSR>=0.50)
populations.question: How much genuinely distinct search does the qualifying candidate pool represent?
populations.onc_interpretation: Of 42 recorded trials (42 clusterable), ONC finds 8 effectively uncorrelated cluster(s) — an effective-to-raw ratio of 0.19. Read this as: the 42 trials explored roughly 8 genuinely distinct bets; the remainder are correlated variants re-testing the same underlying pattern. CAVEATS (structural, see module docstring): E[K] is bounded to [2, N-1] by construction, k-means under-counts genuinely independent trials, and under-counting LOWERS the expected-max-Sharpe hurdle — so treat E[K] as a lower bound on search breadth to read alongside the raw count of 42, not as a replacement for it. Mean silhouette 0.594 (near 0 = weak cluster structure, near 1 = strong).
